records.role: Assembles constant-gamma engine performance: Me, Pe, CF ideal/actual, c*, thrust, mass flow and Isp with the η_c*/η_CF split applied to the correct quantities.
relations: Pe/Pc = isentropic_pressure_ratio(Me, γ); Pe = Pe/Pc · Pc
Cf_ideal = thrust_coefficient(Me, γ, Pe/Pc, Pa/Pc, ε)
records.relations_text: At = π·Rt²; Ae = At·ε Me = mach_from_area_ratio(ε, γ, supersonic=True) Pe/Pc = isentropic_pressure_ratio(Me, γ); Pe = Pe/Pc · Pc Cf_ideal = thrust_coefficient(Me, γ, Pe/Pc, Pa/Pc, ε) Cf_actual = Cf_ideal · eta_CF c_star_eff = c_star · eta_cstar thrust = Cf_actual · Pc · At m_dot = Pc · At / c_star_eff Isp = Cf_actual · c_star_eff / g0 Ve = Isp · g0 exit_temperature = Tc · (1 + (γ−1)/2 · Me²)^−1
outputs: EnginePerformance: Me, Pe, Pe_over_Pc, Cf_ideal, Cf_actual, c_star, c_star_effective, At, Ae, thrust, m_dot, Isp, Ve, eta_Isp, eta_cstar, eta_CF, exit_temperature, expansion_model='constant_gamma'
validity_statements: Nozzle efficiency acts on the thrust coefficient; combustion efficiency acts on c* (and therefore on the mass flow needed to hold Pc).  Isp = Cf_actual·c*_eff/g0 = eta_CF·eta_cstar·Isp_ideal, so the net Isp multiplier is unchanged from a lumped eta_Isp while thrust and mass flow are now attributed to the correct physics.
